newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN shares rise on strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: MAN shares rise on strong dollar.

text.p: Shares in German truck maker and engineering group MAN AG rose strongly on Tuesday on the back of the firmer dollar.
In bourse trade, MAN shares rose early on to a new year-high of 511 marks before settling at 502 marks, 24 marks or five percent up on the day.
The firmer dollar, gaining to 1.733 marks, was seen as positive for the value of MAN's exports, dealers noted. They also said there was an "aggressive large purchaser" of MAN stock in the market.
The wider DAX index traded some 1.4 percent higher.
